name: BoxBox Self-Hosted File Manager
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted web file manager for mounted Linux directories with previews, resumable file/folder uploads, text editing and share links; no vendor-imposed storage or transfer quota in the software.
watch_out: You must supply storage, Docker/server capacity, backups and network security; no hosted storage allowance is included. The app can modify files on mounted volumes, so restrict mounts and sharing permissions. Provider branding and external infrastructure costs are separate.
